## Survey Design Methodology

Our project aims to survey the the primary faculty across Trinity College. We chose to keep our sampling frame to primary faculty because we did not want to include secondary faculty that might be on different tracks (clean this up).

We first started by looking at the website for Trinity College of Arts and Science (<https://trinity.duke.edu/>). Here, they break down their departments into three strata: Arts & Humanities, Natural Sciences, and Social Science.
